baseline.scope_en: Curated planet-native or planet-event routes for strategic rare and late-game materials. Common mid-game materials and space-only POIs are not marked.
baseline.scope_zh: 只標示由特定星球原生資源或星球事件開啟的稀有／後期戰略材料路線；常見中期材料與純太空興趣點不列入星球標記。

routes.name_zh: 石墨 → 富勒烯 → 超級冷卻液
routes.availability_en: Graphite is native and exclusive to the lower half of the Water Asteroid in Spaced Out. Fullerene is the processed product; it is not native terrain here. A Gilded Asteroid Field is a separate renewable space-POI route.
routes.availability_zh: 《太空拓荒》中，石墨原生且只出現在水域小行星下半部；富勒烯是加工產物，不是此星球的原生地形資源。鍍金小行星帶則是另一條可再生的太空興趣點路線。
production_en: Molecular Forge: 90 kg Graphite + 5 kg Sulfur + 5 kg Aluminum = 100 kg Fullerene.
Emulsifier: 1 kg Fullerene + 49.5 kg Gold + 49.5 kg Petroleum = 100 kg Super Coolant.
production_zh: 分子熔爐：90 公斤石墨 + 5 公斤硫 + 5 公斤鋁 = 100 公斤富勒烯。
乳化機：1 公斤富勒烯 + 49.5 公斤金 + 49.5 公斤石油 = 100 公斤超級冷卻液。
uses_en: Super Coolant has the game's lowest freezing point and exceptionally high specific heat capacity, making liquid oxygen and liquid hydrogen production much easier.
It is also the preferred coolant for deep cryogenic loops and sour-gas-to-methane condensation.
uses_zh: 超級冷卻液具有遊戲中最低凝固點與極高比熱容，可大幅降低製造液態氧、液態氫的難度。
也適合深低溫冷卻迴路，以及將酸性氣體冷凝成液態甲烷。
attention_en: Reaching the Water Asteroid does not by itself complete the chain; Sulfur, Aluminum, Gold, Petroleum and the two late-game processing buildings are still required.
Do not confuse terrain availability with guaranteed mass: the site shows possible worldgen sources, not seed probability or quantity.
attention_zh: 抵達水域小行星並不等於完成整條產線；仍需硫、鋁、金、石油，以及兩座後期加工建築。
不要把地形來源誤解成保證數量：本站只表示世界生成候選來源，不代表種子機率或實際儲量。

routes.name_zh: 鈮 → 超導體 → 塑膠質
routes.availability_en: The Superconductive Asteroid contains low-mass Niobium patches embedded in Obsidian and Magma and a renewable Molten Niobium Volcano.
routes.availability_zh: 超導小行星有包在黑曜石與岩漿中的低質量鈮礦塊，並有可再生的熔融鈮火山。
production_en: Molecular Forge: 5 kg Niobium + 95 kg Tungsten = 100 kg Thermium.
Metal Refinery: 100 kg Thermium = 100 kg Niobium. After the first batch, this bootstraps Niobium while consuming Tungsten; do not use the Rock Crusher, which recovers only 50%.
Molecular Forge: 15 kg Thermium + 70 kg Plastic + 15 kg Brackwax = 100 kg Plastium.
production_zh: 分子熔爐：5 公斤鈮 + 95 公斤鎢 = 100 公斤超導體。
金屬精煉器：100 公斤超導體 = 100 公斤鈮。第一批完成後可用鎢擴增鈮；不要用碎石機，碎石機只回收 50%。
分子熔爐：15 公斤超導體 + 70 公斤塑膠 + 15 公斤鹹乳蠟 = 100 公斤塑膠質。
uses_en: Niobium adds +500 °C building overheat tolerance; Thermium adds +900 °C and has very high thermal conductivity.
Thermium enables extreme-temperature Aquatuners, sour-gas boilers and other builds that exceed Steel's +200 °C bonus.
Plastium gives plastic-category buildings +900 °C overheat tolerance while retaining low thermal conductivity.
uses_zh: 鈮可讓建築過熱溫度提高 500°C；超導體提高 900°C，且具有極高導熱率。
超導體可用於超高溫液溫調節器、酸性氣體鍋爐，以及其他超過鋼材 200°C 加成能力的設備。
塑膠質可讓塑膠類建築提高 900°C 過熱溫度，同時維持低導熱率。
attention_en: Reserve at least the first 5 kg of Niobium for a Thermium batch. Building directly from scarce Niobium is usually worse than using Thermium.
Native patches sit beside Magma and the volcano emits molten metal; use vacuum, safe access and controlled cooling.
Thermium is still limited by Tungsten. Plastium additionally requires Brackwax, so this planet is only one bottleneck in that chain.
attention_zh: 至少保留最初 5 公斤鈮來製造第一批超導體；把稀少的鈮直接拿去蓋建築通常不如使用超導體。
原生礦塊緊鄰岩漿，火山也會噴出熔融金屬；應使用真空隔熱、安全通道與受控冷卻。
超導體仍受鎢供應限制；塑膠質另需鹹乳蠟，因此此星球只解決產線的一個瓶頸。

routes.name_zh: 實驗體 52B → 原生膠 → 異構膠晶
routes.stage_en: Late game / perfect insulation and liquid locks
routes.availability_en: Experiment 52B is guaranteed on the Marshy Asteroid and cannot be uprooted or cultivated. If a cluster remix replaces the Marshy Asteroid, the experiment and one Tungsten Volcano move to the replacement fragment.
routes.availability_zh: 草澤小行星保證有實驗體 52B，且不能挖起或人工種植。若星團混搭取代草澤小行星，實驗體與一座鎢火山會移到替代碎片星球。
production_en: Experiment 52B consumes edible food and produces 1 kg Sap per 200 kcal.
Heat Sap above 125 °C away from the tree: 25% becomes Isosap and 75% becomes Steam.
Molecular Forge: 15 kg Isosap + 80 kg Abyssalite + 5 Reed Fiber or 5 Feather Fiber = 100 kg Insulite.
Emulsifier: 35 kg Isosap + 65 kg Petroleum = 100 kg Visco-Gel Fluid.
production_zh: 實驗體 52B 消耗可食用食物；每 200 千卡產生 1 公斤原生膠。
把原生膠移離實驗體後加熱至 125°C 以上：25% 轉為異構膠晶，75% 轉為蒸汽。
分子熔爐：15 公斤異構膠晶 + 80 公斤深淵晶石 + 5 單位蘆葦纖維或 5 單位羽絨纖維 = 100 公斤隔熱質。
乳化機：35 公斤異構膠晶 + 65 公斤石油 = 100 公斤凝膠。
uses_en: Insulite has near-zero thermal conductivity and is best used in insulated pipes and tiles for effectively locked-down heat transfer.
Visco-Gel Fluid stacks vertically without spreading horizontally, making compact liquid locks and unusual liquid structures possible.
The same Marshy route also guarantees Tungsten Volcanoes, supporting the Tungsten side of Thermium production.
uses_zh: 隔熱質的導熱率接近零，製成隔熱管線與隔熱磚時可近乎封鎖熱交換。
凝膠可垂直堆疊而不向左右流動，適合緊湊液封與特殊液體結構。
同一條草澤路線也保證有鎢火山，可支援製造超導體所需的鎢。
attention_en: Experiment 52B attacks nearby Duplicants and Critters. Deliver food beneath it with minimal direct access.
Keep the tree and its output above about 17 °C; frozen Sap can form natural tiles that stifle the tree. Do not heat Sap to 125 °C beside the tree.
There is only one tree. Production consumes colony food, and Insulite also needs mined Abyssalite plus Reed Fiber or Feather Fiber.
attention_zh: 實驗體 52B 會攻擊靠近的複製人與生物；應把食物送到它下方並減少直接接近。
讓實驗體與產物保持在約 17°C 以上；凍結的原生膠可能形成自然磚並阻塞實驗體。也不要在實驗體旁直接加熱到 125°C。
每個星團只有一棵實驗體；產線會消耗殖民地食物，製造隔熱質還需可挖掘深淵晶石，以及蘆葦纖維或羽絨纖維。

routes.name_zh: 瓦斯牛 → 鹹乳 → 鹹乳蠟 → 塑膠質
routes.stage_zh: 後期／可再生塑膠質材料
routes.availability_en: The Moo Asteroid is the natural home of Gassy Moos and Gas Grass. This is a native renewable Brackene route, not an exclusive requirement: Brackene also has food-crop recipes.
routes.availability_zh: 牧場小行星是瓦斯牛與瓦斯草的原生地。這是可再生鹹乳的原生路線，但不是唯一解法；鹹乳也可使用農作物配方製造。
production_en: A happy, fed Gassy Moo can be milked every 4 cycles for 200 kg Brackene.
Brackwax Gleaner: 1,000 g/s Brackene = 90 g/s Brackwax + 810 g/s Brine + 100 g/s Carbon Dioxide.
Heating 1,000 g Brackene above 83 °C instead yields 100 g Brackwax + 900 g Brine.
Molecular Forge: 15 kg Thermium + 70 kg Plastic + 15 kg Brackwax = 100 kg Plastium.
production_zh: 快樂且有進食的瓦斯牛每 4 週期可擠取 200 公斤鹹乳。
鹹乳蠟收集器：每秒 1,000 公克鹹乳 = 90 公克鹹乳蠟 + 810 公克鹵水 + 100 公克二氧化碳。
把 1,000 公克鹹乳加熱到 83°C 以上，則可得到 100 公克鹹乳蠟 + 900 公克鹵水。
分子熔爐：15 公斤超導體 + 70 公斤塑膠 + 15 公斤鹹乳蠟 = 100 公斤塑膠質。
uses_en: Brackwax is the special intermediate required for Plastium.
Plastium is the extreme-heat replacement for Plastic in Transit Tubes, mini pumps, Radbolt Joint Plates, Remote Worker Docks and other plastic-category buildings.
uses_zh: 鹹乳蠟是製造塑膠質所需的特殊中間材料。
塑膠質可在運輸管道、迷你泵、輻射粒子接合板、遠端作業塢等塑膠類建築中取代塑膠，用於極高溫環境。
attention_en: Moos do not lay eggs. Keep them fed to build Accu-Moo-Lation, then give a 100% charged Moo direct sunlight or a view into space so it can call a replacement; continuous feeding takes about 16 cycles.
Brackwax melts irreversibly into Naphtha above about 162.9 °C; remove it quickly if using a hot conversion chamber.
This route still requires Thermium from the Niobium/Tungsten chain and ordinary Plastic.
attention_zh: 牧場牛不會產蛋；持續餵食約 16 週期可累積至 100% 召牛進度，此時還要讓牧場牛看見太空或直射陽光，才能召喚替代個體。並應保留瓦斯草或其他有效飼料路線。
鹹乳蠟在約 162.9°C 以上會不可逆地熔成石腦油；若用高溫轉換室，必須迅速移出產物。
此路線仍需鈮／鎢產線製造的超導體，以及一般塑膠。

routes.stage_zh: 限時事件／高於鋼材的耐熱金屬
routes.availability_en: Relica, Relica Minor and RelicAAAAAAAGHH starts include the Demolior event. Iridium is awarded through impact material or successful defense rewards; it is not ordinary worldgen ore before that event.
routes.availability_zh: 遺蹟星、迷你遺蹟星與遺蹟啊啊啊啊啊星開局包含毀滅者事件。銥來自撞擊材料或成功防禦後的獎勵；事件前它不是一般世界生成礦物。
production_en: Letting Demolior impact creates a large one-time Iridium deposit in the destroyed impact zone.
Destroying Demolior triggers a one-time Iridium meteor shower and, in Spaced Out, renewable debris POIs containing Iridium or Molten Iridium.
production_zh: 讓毀滅者撞擊會在被摧毀的撞擊區形成大量一次性銥礦。
擊毀毀滅者會觸發一次性銥流星雨；在《太空拓荒》中也會產生含銥或熔融銥的可再生碎片興趣點。
uses_en: Iridium adds +500 °C building overheat tolerance, exceeding Steel's +200 °C bonus.
Its very high thermal conductivity makes it suitable for hot Aquatuners and oil/petroleum boiling where Steel may overheat.
uses_zh: 銥可讓建築過熱溫度提高 500°C，高於鋼材的 200°C 加成。
銥的導熱率極高，適合高溫液溫調節器、原油與石油沸騰設備等鋼材可能過熱的用途。
attention_en: This is a timed, destructive event. The default impact is cycle 200; RelicAAAAAAAGHH forces cycle 10, and difficulty settings can alter or disable the timer.
An impact destroys terrain, buildings, critters, Duplicants and even geysers in the marked zone. A successful defense also causes a damaging Iridium meteor shower.
Iridium has hardness 200 and requires the tier-3 Super-Duperhard Digging skill when mined as natural tiles.
attention_zh: 這是有時間限制且具有破壞性的事件；預設在第 200 週期撞擊，遺蹟啊啊啊啊啊星強制第 10 週期，難度設定可改變或停用倒數。
撞擊會摧毀標記區內的地形、建築、生物、複製人，甚至間歇泉；成功防禦後的銥流星雨同樣具有破壞性。
銥的硬度為 200；挖掘自然磚形式的銥需要第 3 級「極硬物挖掘」技能。

routes.stage_en: Mid-late game / nuclear power and radiation
routes.availability_en: These world variants include Uranium Ore in at least one referenced terrain. Full Radioactive Biomes may also contain Beetas; worlds with only small Uranium-sprinkle terrain are not guaranteed a hive.
routes.availability_zh: 這些星球變體至少有一個引用地形列出鈾礦；完整放射性生態區還可能有鈾蜂，但只有少量鈾礦點綴地形的星球不保證有蜂巢。
production_en: Uranium Centrifuge: 10 kg Uranium Ore = 2 kg Enriched Uranium + 8 kg Liquid Uranium.
Beeta Hive: 1 kg Uranium Ore = 0.9 kg Enriched Uranium, making hives far more mass-efficient where Beetas exist.
production_zh: 鈾離心機：10 公斤鈾礦 = 2 公斤濃縮鈾 + 8 公斤液態鈾。
鈾蜂巢：1 公斤鈾礦 = 0.9 公斤濃縮鈾；有鈾蜂時，蜂巢的質量效率遠高於離心機。
uses_en: Enriched Uranium fuels Research Reactors for high-output power and large heat production.
Uranium Ore also fuels Radiation Lamps and Manual Radbolt Generators; Beetas and hives can provide strong ambient radiation for Radbolt collection.
uses_zh: 濃縮鈾可作為研究反應爐燃料，提供高輸出電力並產生大量熱。
鈾礦也可供輻射燈與手動輻射粒子產生器使用；鈾蜂與蜂巢可提供強環境輻射，供輻射粒子收集。
attention_en: Mining natural Uranium Ore destroys half its mass. Awake Beetas are hostile; sleeping Beetas emit about 1,440 rads/cycle, while the Beeta Hive briefly exceeds 1,800 rads/cycle when processing ore.
Carbon Dioxide can put Beetas to sleep for safer handling, but radiation exposure, reactor heat and Nuclear Waste still require containment and cooling.
Enriched Uranium debris itself does not emit radiation; do not count it as an ambient-radiation source.
attention_zh: 直接挖掘自然鈾礦會損失一半質量；鈾蜂回收率高得多。清醒的鈾蜂具有敵意；睡眠中的鈾蜂約放出每週期 1,440 拉德，鈾蜂巢處理鈾礦時則會短暫超過每週期 1,800 拉德。
二氧化碳可讓鈾蜂睡眠以便安全操作，但仍需控制輻射暴露、反應爐熱量與核廢料。
濃縮鈾碎屑本身不會放出輻射，不可把它當成環境輻射來源。

sources.title: Molecular Forge will not let me craft Super Coolant
So now I have Thermium. What to do with it?
